_comment: Scenario C: one long/heavy high-seq request (qwen_1328, seq_len 6889 > long_request_seq_len) arrives first; several medium requests (flux1_1024, seq_len 4096) arrive mid-flight. Tests whether keeping the long request on CP while absorbing the shorter ones as DP replicas (shape_aware_ratio / early_hot_switch) beats both static policies. static_cp serializes everything on one 2-GPU group; static_dp runs the heavy request on a single slow GPU.
